summary: Record the Nex Core 0.2.7 ISO and package build (carrying BUG-0195) and its publication to the signed APT archive and the website download tree, with the public HTTPS verification. API impact: none — release evidence only.

guide.reason: Release evidence only; operator install and update workflows are unchanged by publication.

api.reason: API impact: none. Build and publication record; no Controller, Core or client contract changes.

roadmap.reason: Patch release publication; no milestone or acceptance gate change.

state.reason: Release artifacts on the website host are distribution output, not product state.

verification.method: Local build exit 0 and package versions checked with dpkg-deb; tracked source identical to commit d597e8f; BUG-0195 start-time memory refusal present in the Core executable; publication verified over public HTTPS (InRelease, Packages listing both 0.2.7 packages with matching sizes, ISO sha256 equal to the build, latest serving 0.2.7) and both published packages re-downloaded with SHA-256 equal to the build.
